title: Chapter 46 — The Property Manager
intro: The volume buyer — unit turns, standard-unit programs, and frictionless service.

sections.title: Volume and Simplicity
sections.content:
Property managers buy frequently but at lower price points. They need speed, simplicity, and consistency. A standard-unit program — pre-selected models at pre-negotiated prices — eliminates decision-making friction on every order.

The value proposition is volume and loyalty in exchange for competitive pricing and reliable service.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating property manager relationships, ask:

Is there a standard-unit program in place — or does every order start from scratch?
Is ordering frictionless — or does it require multiple calls and approvals?
Is the relationship producing consistent volume?
